cases.name: GeocodeServer metadata
cases.notes: candidateFields and categories are not advertised.

cases.name: Find Address Candidates
cases.notes: Honors singleLine/structured fields, maxLocations, outSR (reprojected via the shared transform service), countryCode(s), and searchExtent.

cases.name: Geocode Addresses (batch)
cases.notes: Accepts the Esri addresses={"records":[...]} payload and a bare records array. Honors outSR (reprojected via the shared transform service) and countryCode(s); enforces the provider batch-size cap.

cases.name: Reverse Geocode
cases.notes: Honors location, outSR (reprojected via the shared transform service), langCode, and the provider-dependent distance (search radius, meters) and featureTypes (type filter) parameters where a backing provider supports them (Azure Maps radius/entityType).

cases.name: Suggest
cases.notes: Honors text, maxSuggestions, countryCode(s), searchExtent, and location bias where the provider supports them.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

cases.name: provider
cases.notes: Honua extension to select a registered provider.

cases.name: singleLine, address, city, region, postal, countryCode, maxLocations, countryCodes
outSR
cases.notes: Output coordinates are reprojected to the requested WKID via the shared coordinate-transform service; a transform the service cannot perform returns 400.

cases.name: searchExtent
cases.notes: Accepts xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax or an Esri envelope JSON in the default SR; forwarded to the provider as a search/view bounds.

cases.name: outFields
cases.notes: Projects the returned attributes to the requested fields (case-insensitive); * or omitted returns all; an empty token returns 400.

cases.name: category, magicKey, location, matchOutOfRange, forStorage
cases.notes: Re-deferred: no backing provider exposes these on the shared geocode interface (forward category/magicKey resolution, out-of-range interpolation, and storage/billing flags are unsupported by Nominatim, Azure Maps, and Amazon Location). Accepted but not applied.

cases.name: location
cases.notes: Required; x,y or JSON {x,y}/{lon,lat}.

cases.name: outSR
cases.notes: Output coordinates are reprojected to the requested WKID via the shared coordinate-transform service; a transform the service cannot perform returns 400.

cases.name: langCode
cases.notes: Forwarded to providers that support localized results.

cases.name: distance
cases.notes: Positive search radius in meters (non-positive returns 400); forwarded as the canonical request DistanceMeters and honored by providers that bound the reverse search by radius (Azure Maps radius). Nominatim and Amazon Location ignore it.

cases.name: featureTypes
cases.notes: Comma-delimited Esri feature-type tokens forwarded as the canonical request FeatureTypes and honored by providers that filter reverse matches by type (Azure Maps entityType). Nominatim and Amazon Location ignore it.

cases.name: searchExtent, location
cases.notes: Forwarded to providers that honor suggestion bounds/bias.

cases.name: outSR
cases.notes: Output coordinates are reprojected to the requested WKID via the shared coordinate-transform service; a transform the service cannot perform returns 400.
